notes.title: Join The Beta
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2354840/extras/BetaBanner_-_.png?t=1681033195[/img]

Hey folks,

The game is coming along great, but we need your help in improving "The Guestlist". We have decided to launch a beta to receive some feedbacks on the game.

We are still doing some finishing touches on the beta, and it will take place around May 2023, for the span of one week. In the beta, you get to play a small portion of the game, kind of like a demo.

There won't be any major story spoilers and it will take place in the middle section of the game.

If you're interesting in participating in the beta, you may sign up on our website below:

[url=https://theguestlistgame.com/]https://theguestlistgame.com/[/url]

You will receive notification on when the beta will start once we have a exact date in place.
